title: Sierpinski
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Sierpinski
learningObjectives: Trace how each recursion level subdivides a triangle into three smaller triangles at its corners
Predict how raising the depth slider from 1 to 7 multiplies the triangle count by three at each level
Identify the recursion depth limit as the base case that terminates the subdivision
Explain what makes the Sierpinski triangle self-similar: any sub-triangle is a scaled copy of the whole
Compare the deterministic subdivision version with the random chaos-game version that converges on the same fractal
